statement: Written BEFORE any TEST image was OCR'd. TEST results do not change OCR settings, fallback or models.
selection_rule: lowest corpus CER of HINGLISH-normalised OCR vs HINGLISH-normalised reference text; ties -> 'none' (simplest)
test_population: all 758 canonical TEST memes (no sampling, no easy-example filtering)

conditions.REFERENCE: dataset caption, model-native preprocessing (= Task 13 predictions)
conditions.OCR_NATIVE: OCR text through the model's own frozen preprocessing (deployable pipeline)
conditions.OCR_RAW_ONLY: OCR text WITHOUT preprocessing fed to hinglish-trained final models (mismatch ablation)
conditions.OCR_BASIC_ONLY: OCR text with BASIC only (hinglish step skipped) fed to hinglish-trained models (ablation)
conditions.OCR_NATIVE_WITH_FALLBACK: M04 with the fallback policy: image-only I03 when OCR fails / is empty / low confidence

uncertainty: paired bootstrap 10,000 resamples, seed 42 (REFERENCE vs OCR on the same samples)
